description: Hybrid LUT/transformer. Vanilla GPT-2 backbone (token+pos embed, weight-tied head, exp001-style ln_f) but each block is: pre-norm LN -> VectorToDominance(d_head=E=384, n_pairs=D=3297, n_heads=H=6, smooth_mode=True) producing [B,T,H,D] per-head dominance views -> per-head Linear(D, E/H) for Q,K,V (no bias, std=0.02 init) -> standard causal SDPA -> concat to [B,T,E] -> single LUT out_proj (MultiHeadLut, tph=384, nap=6, n_outputs=32, smooth=False, n_alt=1) + SparseScatter to E -> add residual. weight_decay=0 on LUT weights only (per exp191). Total ~40M params.
